judgement.L01: Three original diagrams distinguish scales, transfers and particle mean/total. Thermometer source searched; no verified freely reusable instrument asset selected. The introduction immediately preceding this lesson has a substantial new NASA thermal-testing image. Here an instrument photo would add less than the three explanations; substantive illustrated reading retained, no claim that diagrams alone discharge the search requirement.
judgement.L02: Original energy-balance diagram and purposeful capacity explorer with static table; calorimeter candidates considered during drafting, no verified suitable asset selected. The visual sequence moves from boundary to balance and interactive endpoint, rather than repeating the introductory thermal-chamber photo.
judgement.L03: New sourced facility photograph plus linked three-panel mathematical graph.
judgement.L04: Authentic data plots, residual plot and different sourced apparatus photograph.
judgement.L05: Original method-selection map supports synthesis; exercise/reference space devoted to attempted reasoning and worked feedback. No arbitrary repeated image.
judgement.reference: Compact retrieval table/PDF; branding only, no repeated teaching photograph.

interactive.source: Original endpoint explorer; optional PhET teacher guide comparison, not copied simulation
interactive.question: How does increasing the cooler body capacity move equilibrium and energy received?
interactive.conditions: Positive constant capacities, no phase change/work/external transfer; fixed initial temperatures.
interactive.alternatives: Static four-case table and worked reasoning; no animation.
interactive.checks: Endpoint arithmetic checked; native range keyboard/reset, reduced motion and noJS alternative checked in integrated review.

dataset.licence: GNU GPLv2, full COPYING-R.txt and original cars-source.R packaged with CSV and plots. Separate aggregate from original teaching/code.
dataset.changes: CSV headers renamed and row number added; 50 pairs/order unchanged; SI conversion in analysis, no rounded input replacement.
dataset.plotting: Original SVG geometry from all50 records, axes/units/markers/captions verified against source; dataset provenance retained.
dataset.limitations: Historical metadata sparse; original Ezekiel1930 book cited by R but not inspected. No invented uncertainties or protocol. Parameters illustrative and inspected on same data; sensitivity included.
